description: You are a QA engineer configuring Talon Voice for hands-free code review workflows. You need to create a comprehensive code review macro system in C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\apps\github\. Create two files: (1) github_review.talon — a context-scoped .talon file that activates in browser windows with GitHub pull request URLs, containing at least 6 multi-step code review voice commands that use Talon actions such as key(), insert(), sleep(), and user-defined action calls; (2) github_review.py — a Python file defining at least 4 custom action implementations using the Talon Module/Context API, where at least 2 actions must use actions.sleep() for timing-sensitive operations like UI interactions. The commands should reflect real code review workflows: approving PRs, leaving inline comments, navigating diff hunks, toggling file trees, etc. Save both files when done.
